name: Sparks
description: The pointer sheds small sparks as it moves. Faster motion throws more of them. Each spark leaves the path in its own direction, arcs under gravity and burns out after a short life, with its colour shifting from the first colour to the second as it goes. Clicking throws an extra handful of sparks out from the press point. The pointer can be made to shed nothing until it passes a chosen speed, and the path sparks launch from can be smoothed so an unsteady hand still gets a clean curve.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Sparks per step
parameters.description: How many sparks a fast-moving pointer can shed from each point on its path

parameters.name: Gravity
parameters.description: How strongly sparks fall (px per second squared)

parameters.name: Spread
parameters.description: How fast sparks fly away from the path

parameters.name: Activation speed
parameters.description: Pointer speed below which no sparks are shed (px per second), 0 to always shed them

parameters.name: Smoothing
parameters.description: How much the path sparks launch from is smoothed, 0 to follow it exactly

parameters.name: Click burst
parameters.description: How many extra sparks a click throws from the press point, 0 to disable

parameters.name: Birth colour
parameters.description: Colour of a freshly shed spark

parameters.name: Burnout colour
parameters.description: Colour a spark fades toward before it is gone
